name: Pulse Ring
description: Multiple concentric rings expand outward and fade away creating a ripple/pulse effect

variations.name: default
variations.description: Staggered rings emanate from the center, scaling up and fading out like ripples on water

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the loader container in pixels

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the loader container in pixels

props.name: thickness
props.description: Stroke width of each ring in pixels

props.name: isAnimating
props.description: Controls whether the animation runs. Set to false to pause animation.
